## Owner-Confirmed Decisions

- 2026-07-26: `My_skills` is the central navigation and source hub.
- 2026-07-26: The original four direct utility skills live only in
  `50-core-utils/`; projects do not store copies or configuration for them.
- 2026-07-26: `skill-registry` also lives in `50-core-utils/`, but remains
  version-management infrastructure rather than a direct central Skill.
- 2026-07-26: Shared skills that must physically exist in a project may be
  released and locked through `skill-registry`; `reader-learner 1.0.0` is the
  current example.
- 2026-07-26: Project-owned skills remain in their projects and are exposed here
  through navigation shortcuts.
- 2026-07-26: `project-agent-generator-skill` stores project-local long-term
  memory under `.agents/memory/` by default and installs the marked entry point
  inside `.agents/AGENTS.md`; it does not create a root `AGENTS.md`.
- 2026-07-26: A trusted project-local `.codex/` SessionStart/SubagentStart Hook
  explicitly loads `.agents/AGENTS.md`; the optional terminal launcher stays
  under `.agents/scripts/`, and no global Codex configuration is required.
- 2026-07-26: The project root keeps only `README.md`; all Agent context,
  navigation details, long-term knowledge, and tool sources live in subdirectories.
- 2026-07-26: The former `00-overview/` inventory and Utils architecture were
  consolidated into the root `README.md` and the duplicate directory was removed.
  The bilingual entrypoint decision dated 2026-09-13 supersedes the single-README
  portion of this historical decision.
- 2026-08-27: `academic-figure-workflow` is maintained directly under
  `10-paper-build/` as a central paper-building Skill. It is not classified as a
  core utility and does not receive a project-local `.agents/` knowledge bundle.
- 2026-09-10: `logic-chain-tutor` is maintained directly under `90-personal/` as
  the personal Skill's unique source. The former external source and
  `personal-skills.lnk` navigation entry are no longer used.
- 2026-09-11: `research-workspace-governance` and `research-project-pipeline` are
  maintained directly under `50-core-utils/`, expanding the direct central set
  from four to six. Their `.pipeline-interface-backups/` material is retained as
  rollback evidence and is not treated as an active Skill source.
- 2026-09-12: `logic-chain-tutor` remains a single central source under
  `90-personal/`. Repeated learning behavior was distilled into reusable output
  contracts, formula/object-operation diagnosis, misconception repair, and
  research-method compression without retaining raw conversation text,
  identifiers, or the retired external path in the Skill package.
- 2026-09-13: The root becomes the public
  `jiaqi-Sun2020/codex-skill-hub` monorepo on `main`. The previous root-layout
  rule is superseded: `README.md`, `README.en.md`, `LICENSE`, and `.gitignore` are the
  maintained repository entry files.
- 2026-09-13: `50-core-utils/skill-registry` is integrated into the monorepo with
  its history preserved; it is not published as a separate repository.
- 2026-09-13: PaperTrace's current `reader-learner` is classified as a
  project-owned fork. Central `reader-learner 1.0.0` remains immutable historical
  release material rather than the source for PaperTrace's current behavior.
- 2026-09-13: Retire the legacy utility copies under `S_paper_skills/util_skills/`,
  including `project-agent-generator-skill`; preserve their canonical sources in
  this hub.
- 2026-09-13: Publish original or otherwise relicensable hub content under the
  permissive MIT License. Preserve all third-party license, copyright, and notice
  obligations, and record confirmed Skill influences in both root READMEs.
- 2026-09-14: Mandatory-policy reachability is declared, not inferred. A project
  topology records canonical policy hashes, applicable execution roots, and either
  an explicit reference, verified loader evidence, or an owner-approved isolation.
  `neat-freak` remains the independent bootstrap auditor.
- 2026-09-14: Research equivalence claims use four distinct relation types:
  `matrix_exact`, `matrix_global_phase`, `observational_protocol`, and
  `metric_only`. The governance layer validates records and inference boundaries;
  domain protocols remain responsible for scientific comparison.
- 2026-09-16: The Generator and Pipeline are initial-onboarding components. After
  handoff, Neat-Freak owns routine verified project-information maintenance;
  Generator force-refresh remains legacy recovery only. Neat-Freak may repair
  existing marked Bootstrap wiring only with explicit authorization.
- 2026-09-16: Research Workspace Governance becomes domain-neutral: optional
  project contracts declare governance paths and automation metadata; relocation
  maps preserve historical paths; comparison records retain evidence, review,
  invalidation, and inference boundaries. The fixed relation-type decision from
  2026-09-14 is superseded by domain-Profile or reviewer-owned semantics.
